mapper.sql: s.id, s.user_id, s.student_no, s.major_code, s.grade, s.class_no, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.create_by, s.update_by, s.is_deleted, u.real_name, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, m.name as major_name, m.college_id, m.status as major_status
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM students s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN majors m ON s.major_code = m.code AND s.grade = m.grade AND s.class_no = m.class_no AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE students
student_no = #{et.studentNo},
major_code = #{et.majorCode},
grade = #{et.grade},
class_no = #{et.classNo},
status = #{et.status},
birth_date = #{et.birthDate},
admission_date = #{et.admissionDate},
address = #{et.address},
update_time = NOW(), update_by = #{et.updateBy}
WHERE id = #{et.id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.student_no as studentNo, s.admission_date as admissionDate, m.name as majorName, m.code as majorCode, u.real_name as realName, u.gender, u.email, u.phone, m.grade, m.class_no as classNo, s.status, CASE WHEN s.status = 0 THEN '在读' WHEN s.status = 1 THEN '休学' WHEN s.status = 2 THEN '退学' WHEN s.status = 3 THEN '毕业' ELSE '未知' END as statusText, s.create_time as createTime, s.update_time as updateTime, s.is_deleted as isDeleted FROM students s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN majors m ON s.major_code = m.code AND s.grade = m.grade AND s.class_no = m.class_no WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.user_id as userId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.major_code as majorCode, s.grade, s.class_no as classNo, s.admission_date as admissionDate, s.birth_date as birthDate, s.status, CASE WHEN s.status = 0 THEN '在读' WHEN s.status = 1 THEN '休学' WHEN s.status = 2 THEN '退学' WHEN s.status = 3 THEN '毕业' ELSE '未知' END as statusText, u.real_name as realName, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, s.address, m.name as majorName, c.name as collegeName, s.create_time as createTime, s.update_time as updateTime, s.create_by as createBy, s.update_by as updateBy, s.is_deleted as isDeleted FROM students s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN majors m ON s.major_code = m.code AND s.grade = m.grade AND s.class_no = m.class_no LEFT JOIN colleges c ON m.college_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.student_no as studentNo, u.real_name as realName, u.gender, s.birth_date as birthDate, s.admission_date as admissionDate, u.phone, u.email, s.address, s.major_code as majorCode, m.name as majorName, c.name as collegeName, s.grade, s.class_no as classNo, s.status, CASE WHEN s.status = 0 THEN '在读' WHEN s.status = 1 THEN '休学' WHEN s.status = 2 THEN '退学' WHEN s.status = 3 THEN '毕业' ELSE '未知' END as statusText, s.create_time as createTime, s.update_time as updateTime, s.create_by as createBy, s.update_by as updateBy, CONCAT(s.student_no, ' - ', u.real_name) as displayName FROM students s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN majors m ON s.major_code = m.code LEFT JOIN colleges c ON m.code = c.code WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0
